svg.title: Subnetting a /24 and the DHCP DORA exchange
svg.desc: Borrow host bits to carve address space into subnets; DHCP then leases addresses out of those subnets automatically
svg.text: Subnetting a /24 and the DHCP DORA exchange
Borrow host bits to carve address space into subnets; DHCP then leases addresses out of those subnets automatically
BIT VIEW OF THE LAST OCTET (2 BITS BORROWED → 4 SUBNETS)
Borrowed bits (solid) pick the subnet · remaining 6 bits (light) pick the host inside it
3 · DHCP RELAY — WHEN THE SERVER LIVES ON ANOTHER SUBNET
DORA = Discover, Offer, Request, Ack. Broadcasts stop at routers, so a relay converts them to unicast.
giaddr tells the server which subnet the client is on, so it hands out an address from the right pool.
